(Optional) Add explicit validation that date fields on attendance/advance/bill endpoints also follow YYYY-MM-DD (DATE_REGEX exists but is unused in handlers).
critical_code_review_comments: SEC fixes are correctly applied: validate_owner_site_ids() runs on BOTH create and update supervisor; MONTH_REGEX enforced in /payroll, /summary, /advances; password length checked on create and update supervisor; .env patterns covered in .gitignore.

DATE_REGEX is defined in server.py but never used — body.date on AttendanceSave/AdvanceBody/BillBody is passed raw into Mongo (used only as string equality / regex prefix with re.escape, so no injection risk, but malformed dates can still be stored).
FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown remain deprecated — prefer lifespan context (noted in iteration_1).
